voice: MiMo TTS · Dean · English · 44.1k mono source, 128 kbps mp3

lines.speaker: Raven One
lines.en: Raven team, this is Raven One. Airdrop confirmed — you're on the north side of old Walden. NBK has breached a sealed level under the industrial yard. Find the derrick, confirm the shaft head is still intact, then exfil to the south pickup. Don't get bogged down. This run is just to confirm the door is still open.
lines.zh:
渡鸦小队，这里是「渡鸦一号」。
空投已确认，你现在站在瓦尔登老城北侧。NBK 在城里打穿了一个封存层，就在那片工业堆场底下——找到井架，确认竖井口还在，然后撤到南侧接应点。
别恋战。这一趟只是确认门还开着。

lines.speaker: Raven One
lines.en: The derrick's still showing red. That means there's power below — which means someone's been maintaining it. Watch yourself.
lines.zh: 渡鸦一号：井架还亮着红灯，说明下面的电还在。小心，那也说明有人维护它。

lines.speaker: Raven One
lines.en: Shaft in sight. Don't get too close — NBK left people around the head.
lines.zh: 看到井口了。别靠太近——NBK 在井口周围留了人。

lines.speaker: Raven One
lines.en: Confirmed: shaft head is intact. We can go down. Moving out now.
lines.zh: 确认：竖井口完好，可以下。现在撤。

lines.speaker: Raven One
lines.en: You're down. This is Anvil, level three — dug by the Warsaw Pact in the eighties, sealed in ninety-one, reopened by NBK in twenty twenty-one. Cold storage is at the north end. Those cryo tanks are where the leak started. Bring up three agent samples — it's the only proof of what NBK is doing here. Be advised: pulling samples will trip their alarm.
lines.zh:
你下来了。
这里是铁砧第三层——1980 年代华约挖的，1991 年封的，2021 年被 NBK 重新打开。
北端是封存冷库，那一排低温罐就是当年泄漏的源头。带 3 份制剂样本上来，这是唯一能证明 NBK 在做什么的东西。
注意：取样本会触发他们的警报。

lines.speaker: Raven One
lines.en: Cold storage is north. Emergency lights are still on, so main power's live — stay away from the breaker panels.
lines.zh: 渡鸦一号：冷库在北端。应急灯还亮着，说明主电源没断——别碰配电箱。

lines.speaker: Raven One
lines.en: Alarm's up. They know you're here. Get to the north lift.
lines.zh: 警报响了。他们知道你在这儿了，往北端升降机跑。

lines.speaker: Raven One
lines.en: Careful — the central hall is wide open, and both flanks have rooms.
lines.zh: 小心，中央大厅是开阔地，两侧都有房间。

lines.speaker: Raven One
lines.en: Samples prove what was there, not who did it. USEC sealed a facility of their own under Anvil — NBK's work logs are inside. Bring out two files. The security down there is contract PMC, a lot harder than the crew at the shaft.
lines.zh:
样本只能证明「有什么」，证明不了「谁干的」。
USEC 在铁砧地下封了一个自己的设施，里面有 NBK 的作业记录。拿 2 份文件出来。
那里的守备是 PMC 合同精锐——比井口那批硬得多。

lines.speaker: Raven One
lines.en: Most of the lighting on this level is dead. Navigate by the emergency panels. No white light — you'll be a target.
lines.zh: 渡鸦一号：这层的照明几乎全废了。靠应急灯板认路，别开强光——你会变成靶子。

lines.speaker: Raven One
lines.en: Logs are in hand. Pull out. Don't get greedy with the crates.
lines.zh: 记录到手。撤，别贪箱子。

lines.speaker: Raven One
lines.en: The logs give us a name — the dispatcher who was on duty at the port the day of the lockdown. He's still in the city, and he's willing to talk. Find him and bring him to the boarding point at the pier. He has to arrive alive. Your squad moves with you — don't let him fall behind.
lines.zh:
记录里提到一个名字——封锁当天在港区值班的调度员。
他还在城里，而且愿意说话。找到他，把他带到码头前沿的登船点。
他必须活着到。你的队友会跟着你，别让他掉队。

lines.speaker: Raven One
lines.en: Sea fog over the port. Visibility's fair, but the container yard is full of blind corners. Stick to the lanes — don't cut between the containers.
lines.zh: 渡鸦一号：港区是海雾，能见度一般，但堆场里全是死角。走通道，别钻箱子缝。

lines.speaker: Raven One
lines.en: The asset says he heard movement by the gantry cranes.
lines.zh: 渡鸦一号：线人说他听见龙门吊那边有动静。

lines.speaker: Raven One
lines.en: The asset gave us something: a cargo plane never took off the day of the lockdown. Its hold was loaded with the last of what NBK wanted out. The manifest is in the terminal, but peacekeepers are already on site — they don't want anyone reaching it. You have ninety seconds. The runway is open ground — don't stop out there.
lines.zh:
线人交代了一件事：封锁当天有一架货机没起飞，货舱里是 NBK 要运走的最后一批东西。
航单在航站楼里，但维和部队已经进场了——他们不想让任何人拿到它。
你有 90 秒。跑道是开阔地，别在那儿停。

lines.speaker: Raven One
lines.en: Extraction window opens in ninety seconds. Hold.
lines.zh: 渡鸦一号：接应窗口 90 秒后打开。撑住。

lines.speaker: Raven One
lines.en: They're adding bodies. Run for the east end — the pickup's at the far end of the runway.
lines.zh: 他们加人了。往东端跑，接应车在跑道尽头。

lines.speaker: Raven One
lines.en: Manifest secured. Don't linger on the runway.
lines.zh: 航单到手。别在跑道上停留。

lines.speaker: Raven One
lines.en: You're holding three things: the samples, the logs, the manifest. That leaves one last job — get out of Walden. There's an exfil pass moving through the port. Take it, get on the boat, and leave the zone from the harbor. The blockade won't open for you twice.
lines.zh:
你手里有三样东西：样本、记录、航单。
现在只剩最后一件事——离开瓦尔登。
港口有一张撤离通行证在流通。拿到它，带上船，从港口登船离开禁区。
封锁线不会为你打开第二次。

lines.speaker: Raven One
lines.en: The pass is in the warehouse. Slot it into your exfil pass before you deploy. Don't forget.
lines.zh: 渡鸦一号：证在仓库里，出击前要在「撤离通行证」槽带上。别忘。

lines.speaker: Raven One
lines.en: The boat's waiting.
lines.zh: 渡鸦一号：船在等你。

lines.speaker: Raven One
lines.en: You're on the ground. Stay sharp.
lines.zh: 已落地。保持警觉。

lines.speaker: Raven One
lines.en: Extraction point reached. Hold the zone.
lines.zh: 已到达撤离点。保持在区域内。

lines.speaker: Raven One
lines.en: Extraction confirmed. Good work.
lines.zh: 撤离确认。干得好。

lines.speaker: Raven One
lines.en: Radio signal lost. You're on your own.
lines.zh: 无线电信号丢失。现在只能靠你自己。

lines.speaker: Raven One
lines.en: Objective secure. Victory is ours.
lines.zh: 目标已控制。我们赢了。

lines.speaker: Raven One
lines.en: We've lost the field. Fall back.
lines.zh: 我们失去了战场。撤退。

lines.speaker: Raven One
lines.en: Match drawn. Nobody won this one.
lines.zh: 平局。谁也没赢。

lines.speaker: Raven One
lines.en: Objective captured. Hold it.
lines.zh: 据点已占领。守住它。

lines.speaker: Raven One
lines.en: Squad link down. AI's taking the slot.
lines.zh: 队友断线。AI 已顶替。
